title: Giraffe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <rect x='20' y='18' width='60' height='64' rx='6' fill='#101828'/>

  <rect x='58' y='38' width='12' height='34' rx='5' fill='#F2B543'/>

  <circle cx='63' cy='45' r='3' fill='#A8641A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3' fill='#A8641A'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='63' r='3' fill='#A8641A'/>

  <rect x='38' y='62' width='30' height='18' rx='7' fill='#F7C64A'/>

  <circle cx='57' cy='74' r='3' fill='#B5711F'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#B5711F'/>

  <path d='M38 66 Q31 66 32 73' stroke='#E09B2D' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='55' y='26' width='20' height='14' rx='6' fill='#F7C64A'/>

  <rect x='65' y='33' width='12' height='9' rx='4' fill='#FBD98A'/>

  <circle cx='63' cy='31' r='2' fill='#3B2410'/>
  <circle cx='63.7' cy='30.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6D8'/>

  <circle cx='70' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#B5711F'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M69 40 Q72 41.5 75 40' stroke='#8A5216' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='57' y='38' width='3' height='24' rx='1.5' fill='#B5711F'/>
